source.data: Real, locally generated E2E career. No production or personal account data; no mocked responses, injected UI or edited gameplay.
reproduction: Install repository dependencies with npm ci and the browser with npx playwright install chromium.
Use a fresh disposable loopback PostgreSQL 18 database named touchline_checks; set SQL_HOST, SQL_PORT, SQL_USER, SQL_PASSWORD and SQL_DATABASE for that database only.
Set SQL_TEST_MODE=true, SQL_SCHEMA=touchline_e2e_<fresh UUID without hyphens>, API_PORT=3049 and UI_PORT=5199.
Launch npx concurrently -k --kill-timeout 120000 "tsx scripts/e2e-server.ts" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort" and wait for /api/health/details to report testCareer=true.
Capture the initial overview, squad and academy at 1600x1100, device scale 1, using the default minimal theme.

POST /api/advance with JSON bodies {"days":28}, {"days":28}, then {"days":5}; check every response for success. This plays the career from 1 July to 31 August 2026 and creates real match and finance history.
Capture finances and match centre at 1600x1100. In match centre select the 29 August Birmingham Wanderers v Bristol Wanderers match, Pitch analysis, Shot map, Birmingham Wanderers and All players.
At 1600x1200 open Scouting, select Dan Johnson, then the Scouting tab in his player dossier.
Wait for visible content and loaded fonts before each viewport screenshot. Stop the app gracefully to drop its E2E schema, then stop the disposable database.
